fact.title: muscle:grep--n-cd
fact.body:
### Context
The same 3-command sequence was observed 2× in this session (shadow-worker repetition detection).

### Steps
- grep -n "extractRelativeImports" -A 20 /c/Users/jaroslav/.pi/agent/git/github.com/mastnacek/pi-plugin-dev/src/slice-auditor.ts | head -30
- grep -n "STATIC_IMPORT\s*=" -A 3 /c/Users/jaroslav/.pi/agent/git/github.com/mastnacek/pi-plugin-dev/src/slice-auditor.ts
- cd /d/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-lotusscript-modular && sed -n '1,45p' src/slices/parser/index.ts && echo === && grep -n "export.*checkLotusScriptDiagnostics\|export async function checkLotusScriptDiagnostics" -A 3 src/slices/lsp/*.ts | head -10 && echo === && grep -n "compileAgent\|decompileLss\|decompileDxl" src/slices/parser/agent-parser.ts | head && echo === && grep -n "export function lintModularFolder" -A 5 src/slices/linter/checker.ts && echo === && grep -n "export function formatScorecard" -A 3 src/slices/scorecard/compute.ts
- grep -n "enclosingRegistration" -B 5 -A 30 /c/Users/jaroslav/.pi/agent/git/github.com/mastnacek/pi-plugin-dev/src/i18n-auditor.ts | head -50
- grep -n "USES_TABLE" -A 5 /c/Users/jaroslav/.pi/agent/git/github.com/mastnacek/pi-plugin-dev/src/i18n-auditor.ts | head -12
- cd /d/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-lotusscript-modular && rm src/slices/tools/gotchas-params.ts

### Rule
Run the sequence as one motor chunk with `uma muscle run grep--n-cd --confirm`.
